tools.name: generate_einvoice
tools.description: Generate a KoSIT-verified ZUGFeRD/Factur-X German e-invoice (EN 16931 / E-Rechnung). Returns pdf_b64 (base64 PDF), invoice_number, and the full validation_report. Every invoice returned has passed the official German government KoSIT acceptance gate — the same gate used by federal agencies for B2G submissions. Keywords: ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, E-Rechnung erstellen, Rechnung PDF, German invoice.

tools.name: validate_einvoice
tools.description: Validate an existing ZUGFeRD/Factur-X/E-Rechnung invoice. Accepts a base64-encoded PDF or raw CII XML. Runs the full three-validator check: PDF/A conformance, EN 16931 Schematron, and the official German KoSIT acceptance gate. No authentication required. Keywords: E-Rechnung prüfen, ZUGFeRD validieren, Factur-X check, Rechnung compliance.

tools.name: parse_einvoice
tools.description: Read an existing e-invoice into structured JSON: ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF (base64), XRechnung or EN 16931 CII XML, or UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote XML. Returns number, dates, seller, buyer, lines, VAT breakdown, totals, payment details and notes; amounts stay strings exactly as in the XML. Does not validate (use validate_einvoice). No authentication required. Keywords: E-Rechnung auslesen, XRechnung lesen, ZUGFeRD XML extrahieren, invoice parser.

tools.name: compliance_status
tools.description: Check the e-rechnung engine health: KoSIT + Mustang daemon status and dependency version pins vs. latest releases. Use before bulk invoice generation to confirm the compliance gate is fully operational.
